<script>
/* Current career wishes are collected separately from uploaded resume facts. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const escape=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const text=value=>typeof value==='string'?value.trim():'';
  const key=value=>text(value).normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/g,'').toLowerCase();
  const aliases={
    'B-ai-pm':new Set(['ai产品经理','aipm','人工智能产品经理','aiproductmanager']),
    'B-fde':new Set(['fde','前线部署工程师','fde解决方案工程师','forwarddeployedengineer'])
  };
  function day(value){
    if(typeof value!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value))return null;
    const stamp=Date.parse(value+'T00:00:00Z');
    return Number.isFinite(stamp)&&new Date(stamp).toISOString().slice(0,10)===value?stamp/86400000:null;
  }
  function normalize(raw){
    if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return null;
    const source=typeof raw.goals==='string'?raw.goals.split(/[,，、\n;；]+/):raw.goals;
    if(!Array.isArray(source)||source.some(value=>typeof value!=='string'))return null;
    const seen=new Set(),goals=[];
    for(const value of source){const goal=text(value);if(!goal)continue;if(goal.length>80)return null;const id=key(goal);if(!seen.has(id)){seen.add(id);goals.push(goal);}}
    if(goals.length<1||goals.length>3)return null;
    const today=text(raw.today),deadline=text(raw.deadline),start=day(today),end=day(deadline),hoursPerWeek=Number(raw.hoursPerWeek);
    if(start===null||end===null||end<=start||end-start>366||!Number.isFinite(hoursPerWeek)||hoursPerWeek<1||hoursPerWeek>40)return null;
    return {goals,deadline,today,hoursPerWeek,confirmed:true};
  }
  function supportedRoles(preferences,rolesB=[]){
    const checked=normalize(preferences);if(!checked||!Array.isArray(rolesB))return [];
    const result=[],seen=new Set();
    for(const goal of checked.goals){
      const value=key(goal);
      const role=rolesB.find(item=>item&&item.route==='B'&&aliases[item.id]&&(key(item.title)===value||aliases[item.id].has(value)));
      if(role&&!seen.has(role.id)){seen.add(role.id);result.push(role);}
    }
    return result;
  }
  const monthKey=value=>value&&day(value)!==null?value.slice(0,7):'';
  const monthLabel=value=>monthKey(value).slice(5);
  const monthShift=(value,direction)=>{
    const [year,month]=monthKey(value).split('-').map(Number);
    if(!Number.isFinite(month))return '';
    return new Date(Date.UTC(year,month-1+direction,1)).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  };
  function nextValue(kind,value,direction,min,max){
    if(kind==='hours'){
      const next=value===''?(direction<0?'':min):String(Math.round((Number(value)+direction)*100)/100);
      return next!==''&&Number(next)>=Number(min)&&Number(next)<=Number(max)?next:'';
    }
    if(!value)return direction>0?min:'';
    const shifted=monthShift(value,direction);
    if(!shifted||monthKey(shifted)<monthKey(min)||monthKey(shifted)>monthKey(max))return '';
    return shifted<min?min:shifted;
  }
  const valueLabel=(kind,value)=>kind==='date'?monthLabel(value):value?String(value).padStart(2,'0'):'';
  const rowLabel=(kind,direction)=>kind==='date'?(direction<0?'上一个月':'下一个月'):(direction<0?'减少一小时':'增加一小时');
  function wheelButton(kind,value,direction,min,max,h){
    const next=nextValue(kind,value,direction,min,max);
    return `<button type="button" data-time-shift="${direction}" class="rt-wheel-edge" aria-label="${rowLabel(kind,direction)}" ${next?'':'disabled'}><span>${h(valueLabel(kind,next))}</span><small>${next?(kind==='date'?'月':'小时'):''}</small></button>`;
  }
  function timeFields({hoursId,deadlineId,hours='',deadline='',min,max,h=escape}){
    const availableDate=monthKey(deadline)?deadline:'';
    const availableHours=String(hours??'');
    const year=availableDate?availableDate.slice(0,4):'';
    return `<div class="rt-wheels">
      <div class="rt-wheel-group" data-time-kind="hours" data-time-field="${h(hoursId)}">
        <label class="rt-wheel-label" for="${h(hoursId)}">每周投入时间</label>
        <div class="rt-wheel-window">
          ${wheelButton('hours',availableHours,1,'1','40',h)}
          <div class="rt-wheel-center"><input id="${h(hoursId)}" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="1" max="40" step="any" value="${h(availableHours)}" placeholder="—" aria-label="每周投入时间（小时）" required><small>小时</small></div>
          ${wheelButton('hours',availableHours,-1,'1','40',h)}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="rt-wheel-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="rt-wheel-group rt-wheel-date" data-time-kind="date" data-time-field="${h(deadlineId)}">
        <p class="rt-wheel-label" data-time-year>${year?year+' 年 · 开始投递':'开始投递月份'}</p>
        <div class="rt-wheel-window">
          ${wheelButton('date',availableDate,-1,min,max,h)}
          <button class="rt-wheel-center" type="button" data-time-date-open aria-label="${year?'调整开始投递月份':'选择开始投递月份'}"><strong data-time-month>${monthLabel(availableDate)||'—'}</strong><small>月</small></button>
          ${wheelButton('date',availableDate,1,min,max,h)}
        </div>
        <details class="rt-exact-date"><summary>选具体日期</summary><label class="sr-only" for="${h(deadlineId)}">开始投递日期</label><input id="${h(deadlineId)}" type="date" min="${h(min)}" max="${h(max)}" value="${h(availableDate)}" required></details>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  function updateWheel(group,input){
    const kind=group.dataset.timeKind,{value,min,max}=input;
    for(const button of group.querySelectorAll('[data-time-shift]')){
      const next=nextValue(kind,value,Number(button.dataset.timeShift),min,max);
      button.disabled=!next;
      button.querySelector('span').textContent=valueLabel(kind,next);
      button.querySelector('small').textContent=next?(kind==='date'?'月':'小时'):'';
    }
    if(kind==='date'){
      const year=monthKey(value).slice(0,4);
      group.querySelector('[data-time-year]').textContent=year?year+' 年 · 开始投递':'开始投递月份';
      group.querySelector('[data-time-month]').textContent=monthLabel(value)||'—';
      group.querySelector('[data-time-date-open]').setAttribute('aria-label',year?`调整开始投递月份，当前 ${year} 年 ${monthLabel(value)} 月`:'选择开始投递月份');
    }
  }
  function handleTimeControl(event){
    const group=event.target?.closest?.('[data-time-kind]');
    if(!group)return false;
    const kind=group.dataset.timeKind,input=group.querySelector('input');
    if(event.type==='input'||event.type==='change'){
      if(event.target!==input)return false;
      updateWheel(group,input);
      return true;
    }
    const dateCenter=event.target.closest?.('[data-time-date-open]');
    if(event.type==='click'&&dateCenter){
      group.querySelector('details').open=true;
      input.focus();
      try{input.showPicker?.();}catch{/* An editable date input is visible when unavailable. */}
      return true;
    }
    const button=event.target.closest?.('[data-time-shift]');
    let direction;
    if(event.type==='click'&&button)direction=Number(button.dataset.timeShift);
    if(event.type==='keydown'&&['ArrowDown','ArrowUp'].includes(event.key)&&(event.target===input&&kind==='hours'||dateCenter)){
      direction=(event.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)*(kind==='hours'?-1:1);
      event.preventDefault();
    }
    if(event.type==='wheel'&&event.target.closest?.('.rt-wheel-window')&&event.deltaY&&event.cancelable){
      direction=Math.sign(event.deltaY)*(kind==='hours'?-1:1);
      if(input.value&&!nextValue(kind,input.value,direction,input.min,input.max))return false;
      event.preventDefault();
    }
    if(!direction)return false;
    // Either direction selects the first option from an empty wheel.
    const next=nextValue(kind,input.value,input.value?direction:1,input.min,input.max);
    if(next){
      input.value=next;
      updateWheel(group,input);
      if(!globalThis.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches&&!group.ownerDocument.documentElement.classList.contains('demo-motion-off')){
        const delta=direction*(kind==='hours'?-1:1);
        for(const item of group.querySelectorAll('.rt-wheel-window > *')){
          item.getAnimations?.().forEach(animation=>animation.cancel());
          item.animate?.([{transform:`translateY(${delta*14}px)`},{transform:'none'}],{duration:190,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,.72,.3,1)'});
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
  function render(ctx={}){
    const state=ctx.state||{},h=ctx.h||escape,btn=ctx.btn||((label,action,extra='',kind='primary')=>`<button type="button" class="j-btn ${kind}" data-j-action="${action}" ${extra}>${h(label)}</button>`);
    const start=(typeof ctx.today==='function'?ctx.today():ctx.today)||new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Shanghai'});
    const addDays=ctx.addDays||((date,days)=>new Date(Date.parse(date+'T00:00:00Z')+days*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10));
    const saved=normalize(state.careerPreferences),draft=state.preferenceDraft;
    const deadline=draft?.deadline??saved?.deadline??'';
    const hours=draft?.hoursPerWeek??saved?.hoursPerWeek??'';
    const sourceGoal=text(state.profile?.goal);
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-preferences rt-planner" aria-labelledby="j-preferences-title">
      <header class="rt-planner-head"><p class="ws-kicker">补充当前求职意向</p><h1 id="j-preferences-title">每周能学多久？</h1><p>选一个自己能坚持的节奏。</p></header>
      <form id="j-preferences-form" class="j-card rt-planner-card">
        <label class="j-field rt-goal-field"><span>你希望从事哪些岗位？</span><textarea id="j-preference-goals" rows="2" maxlength="260" placeholder="填写 1–3 个岗位，用顿号、逗号或换行分隔" required>${h(draft?.goals??saved?.goals.join('、')??'')}</textarea></label>
        ${sourceGoal?`<p class="rt-source-wish">简历中写的是「${h(sourceGoal)}」。</p>`:''}
        ${timeFields({hoursId:'j-preference-hours',deadlineId:'j-preference-deadline',hours,deadline,min:addDays(start,1),max:addDays(start,366),h})}
        ${state.error?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>`:''}<div class="j-actions rt-planner-actions">${btn('确认意向，查看准备方向 →','SAVE_CAREER_PREFERENCES')}${btn('返回我的简历','SHOW_RESUME','','ghost small')}</div>
      </form>
    </section>`;
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyPreferences=Object.freeze({normalize,supportedRoles,render,timeFields,handleTimeControl});
})();

</script>
<script>
/* Local, evidence-preserving resume editing. No requests, embedded CV or model claims. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const text=value=>typeof value==='string'?value.trim():'';
  const list=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.filter(item=>typeof item==='string').map(text).filter(Boolean):[];
  const clone=value=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const key=value=>text(value).normalize('NFKC').replace(/[\s，,。；;：:、·•—–“”"'（）()]/g,'').toLowerCase();
  const unique=items=>{const seen=new Set();return items.filter(item=>{const k=key(item);if(!k||seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true;});};
  const action=/^(?:负责|协助|参加|参与|维护|完成|组织|支持|跟进|整理|建立|开展|使用|运用|独立|通过|带领|推动|制定|分析|汇总|实现|制作|对接|担任|承担|主导|设计|收集|筛选|处理|优化|管理|提出|协调|撰写|搭建|辅导|针对|根据|结合|持续|定期|围绕|技术攻关|效率优化|团队统筹|教学产出|教学成果|课堂效果|衔接成效|内容|业绩|我的贡献)/;
  const structural=/^(?:\d+[.、]\s*)?(?:教学实施|课程设计|学生管理|教研与改进|内容|业绩|我的贡献|实习成果|工作成果|项目成果|工作内容|主要职责)[:：]?$/;
  function repair(items){
    const rows=[];
    for(const raw of list(items))for(const line of raw.replace(/\r\n?/g,'\n').split('\n')){
      const value=line.replace(/^[•·●▪◦◆◇►✓\-*]+\s*/,'').replace(/[\t ]+/g,' ').trim();
      if(!value||structural.test(value))continue;
      const previous=rows.at(-1);
      if(previous&&previous.length>=15&&!/[。！？；;]$/.test(previous)&&!action.test(value)&&!/^\d+[.、]/.test(value)&&!/^[^:：]{2,10}[:：]/.test(value))rows[rows.length-1]+=value;
      else rows.push(value);
    }
    return unique(rows);
  }
  function complete(value){return text(value).replace(/[；;，,、\s]+$/,'').replace(/。+$/,'')+'。';}
  function concise(value){
    return text(value).replace(/^(?:工作内容|主要职责|职责描述|项目职责|实习成果|工作成果|项目成果)[:：]\s*/,'')
      .replace(/\bAfter\s+Eﬀects\b/g,'After Effects')
      .replace(/(?:具备(?:较好|良好)的?(?:沟通|学习|执行|团队协作|组织和领导)能力[，,、]?|认真负责[，,、]?|积极主动[，,、]?|希望在[^。]+(?:积累|发展)[^。]*[。]?)/g,'')
      .replace(/[，,]?(?:积累|提升)(?:了)?(?:沟通|执行|组织|学习|团队协作|团队合作)(?:[、及与和]+(?:沟通|执行|组织|学习|团队协作|团队合作))*(?:方面的)?(?:经验|能力)/g,'')
      .replace(/(?:显著|有效地?|明显)(?=提升|提高|改善|维持|降低|增强)/g,'')
      .replace(/[，,]{2,}/g,'，').replace(/^[，,。；;\s]+|[，,；;\s]+$/g,'').trim();
  }
  function generalBullets(rows,max=3){
    const sentences=unique(repair(rows).flatMap(row=>row.split(/(?<=[。！？；;])\s*/)).map(concise).filter(Boolean));
    const score=value=>(/\d/.test(value)?5:0)+(/完成|制作|建立|设计|提出|交付|获|评估|核对|整理/.test(value)?3:0)+(/工具|系统|流程|项目|报告|资料|模型|课堂/.test(value)?1:0)-(/能力|认真|积极|希望|热情/.test(value)?2:0);
    const chosen=new Set(sentences.map((value,index)=>({value,index,score:score(value)})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.index-b.index).slice(0,max).map(item=>item.index));
    return sentences.filter((_value,index)=>chosen.has(index)).map(complete);
  }
  function educationDetails(item,experiences){
    const entries=unique(repair(item.details).flatMap(row=>row.split(/(?<=[。！？])\s*/)).map(concise).filter(Boolean));
    const courses=entries.filter(value=>/^(?:主修|核心|相关|专业)?课程\s*[:：]/.test(value));
    const experienceText=experiences.map(value=>[text(value.organization),text(value.role),...list(value.bullets)].join(' ')).join('\n');
    const duplicatesProject=value=>/数学建模|时间序列|ARIMA|油价预测/.test(value)&&/数学建模|时间序列|ARIMA|油价预测/.test(experienceText)&&!/大广赛|广告艺术大赛|奖学金/.test(value);
    const awards=entries.filter(value=>!courses.includes(value)&&!duplicatesProject(value)&&/(?:获|拿|得|过|通过|入围|晋级|选拔赛|校赛|奖学金|[一二三123]等奖)/.test(value)&&/大广赛|广告艺术大赛|作品|竞赛|比赛|奖学金|奖/.test(value))
      .map(value=>{
        const contest=/(?:参加)?(?:大广赛|大学生广告艺术大赛)/.exec(value);
        if(contest&&/兼职|校内外|销售|工厂|志愿/.test(value.slice(0,contest.index)))value=value.slice(contest.index);
        return complete(value.replace(/且有作品拿/g,'有作品获').replace(/有作品拿/g,'有作品获').replace(/(作品)过校赛/g,'$1通过校赛').replace(/，且/g,'，'));
      });
    const result=[...courses.map(complete),...awards];
    if(result.length)return unique(result).slice(0,3);
    return generalBullets(entries.filter(value=>!duplicatesProject(value)),2);
  }
  const has=(source,pattern)=>pattern.test(source);
  function evidenceBullets(item,index,notes){
    const rows=repair(item.bullets),s=rows.join('\n'),role=text(item.role);
    const graduateMedia=has(s,/文生图/)&&has(s,/图生视频/)&&has(s,/后期(?:合成|整合|制作)/);
    if(graduateMedia){
      const out=[];
      const theme=has(s,/助老|老年人/)&&has(s,/传统工艺/)?'围绕助老与传统工艺主题':has(s,/数字广告/)?'围绕数字广告主题':'';
      if(theme&&has(s,/毕业设计|广告设计|数字广告|视觉广告/))out.push(`${theme}完成数字广告设计与制作，整合视觉素材、动态内容与后期作品。`);
      const tools=['Photoshop','Premiere','After Effects','Unity','Artivive'].filter(tool=>new RegExp(tool.replace(/ /g,'\\s*'),'i').test(s));
      out.push(`搭建“文生图—图生视频—后期合成”内容制作流程${tools.length?`，使用${tools.join('、')}处理与整合素材`:''}。`);
      const issues=[['人物(?:形象)?不一致|人物一致性','人物一致性'],['画面风格|风格统一','画面风格'],['视频连续性','视频连续性']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
      const methods=[['结构化提示词','结构化提示词'],['多模型协作','多模型协作'],['迭代生成','迭代生成']].filter(([pattern])=>s.includes(pattern)).map(([,label])=>label);
      if(issues.length&&methods.length)out.push(`针对${issues.join('、')}问题，通过${methods.join('、')}改进内容质量。`);
      return out.length>=2?out:generalBullets(rows);
    }
    if(has(s,/ARIMA/i)&&has(s,/MATLAB|RMSE|MAPE/i)){
      const out=[],model=/ARIMA\s*\(\s*\d+\s*[,，]\s*\d+\s*[,，]\s*\d+\s*\)/i.exec(s)?.[0]?.replace(/\s/g,'').replace(/，/g,',')||'ARIMA';
      const metrics=['RMSE','MAPE'].filter(value=>new RegExp(value,'i').test(s));
      const horizon=/(?:未来)?\s*(\d+)\s*个月/.exec(s)?.[1];
      const independent=has(s,/独立(?:完成|构建)[^。\n]{0,30}ARIMA/i);
      out.push(`${independent?'独立构建':'参与构建'}${model}模型${metrics.length?`，使用${metrics.join('与')}评估预测误差`:''}${horizon&&has(s,/油价|汽油|柴油/)?`，完成未来${horizon}个月油价预测`:''}。`);
      if(has(s,/移动平均降噪/)&&has(s,/自动ARIMA/i))out.push(`${has(s,/短期噪声|噪声波动/)&&has(s,/固定参数/)?'针对短期噪声与固定参数限制，':''}提出“移动平均降噪＋自动ARIMA选择”组合优化方案。`);
      const coordinated=has(s,/协调|统筹/)&&has(s,/跨学科|跨专业/),award=/(?:校级|学校)(?:一|二|三|[123])等奖/.exec(s)?.[0];
      if(coordinated||award)out.push(`${coordinated?'协调跨学科队友，拆解学习与交付节点':''}${coordinated&&award?'；':''}${award?`团队作品获${award}`:''}。`);
      if(out.length<2)out.push(...generalBullets(rows,2).filter(value=>!value.includes(model)));
      return unique(out).slice(0,3);
    }
    const teaching=/教师|家教|教学|辅导/.test(role+' '+text(item.organization))&&has(s,/教学|辅导|授课|备课/);
    if(teaching){
      const gradeCounts=[...s.matchAll(/([一二三四五六七八九十\d]+)个年级/g)].map(match=>match[1]);
      const values={'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4,'五':5,'六':6};
      const conflict=new Set(gradeCounts.map(value=>values[value]||Number(value))).size>1;
      if(conflict)notes.push(`经历${index+1}的年级数量有不同写法，优化稿暂不保留年级数量，请对照教学资料确认。`);
      const units=/(\d+)\s*个单元/.exec(s)?.[1],hours=/((?:约)?\s*\d+)\s*课时/.exec(s)?.[1]?.replace(/\s/g,''),classSize=/(\d+\s*[-—–至]\s*\d+|\d+)\s*人(?:小班|班级|课堂)?/.exec(s)?.[1]?.replace(/\s/g,'').replace(/[—–至]/g,'-');
      if(has(s,/科学/)&&has(s,/备课|课时/)){
        const out=[],scope=[units?`${units}个单元`:'',hours?`${hours}课时`:''].filter(Boolean).join('、');
        out.push(`承担科学${has(s,/衔接/)?'衔接':''}课程教学${scope?`，完成${scope}的备课与授课`:''}${has(s,/分层备课|差异化教学|按学生起点调整/)?'，按学生起点调整教学安排':''}。`);
        const tasks=[['课堂实验|动手实验','课堂实验'],['分组探究','分组探究'],['趣味游戏|教学游戏|互动游戏|谁是卧底|空气大富翁','互动游戏']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
        const materials=[['PPT|课件','PPT课件'],['配套练习|练习设计','配套练习'],['知识点|思维导图|复习文档','知识点与复习资料']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
        if(tasks.length||materials.length)out.push(`${tasks.length?`设计${tasks.join('、')}`:''}${tasks.length&&materials.length?'，':''}${materials.length?`制作${materials.join('、')}`:''}。`);
        const review=[['作业批改|批改作业','作业批改'],['错题|错题订正','错题复盘'],['单元复习','单元复习'],['综合测试|测评|小测','阶段测评']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
        const management=classSize?`管理${classSize}人小班`:'',assessment=review.length?`通过${review.join('、')}跟踪学习情况`:'';
        const parent=has(s,/家长沟通|家长反馈|与家长|家长/)?'向家长反馈学习进展':'';
        const last=[management,assessment,parent].filter(Boolean).join('，');if(last)out.push(last+'。');
        return unique(out).slice(0,3);
      }
      if(has(s,/小学高年级|全科作业/) && has(s,/英语|语文|数学|科学/)){
        const subjects=['语文','数学','英语','科学'].filter(value=>s.includes(value));
        const out=[`辅导小学高年级${subjects.join('、')}作业${has(s,/薄弱|专项讲解/)?'，针对薄弱环节开展专项讲解':''}。`];
        const parts=[['单词|词汇','词汇'],['语法','语法'],['课文精读|课文','课文'],['口语','口语']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
        const checks=[['阶段小测|阶段测评','阶段小测'],['错题','错题复盘']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
        if(parts.length||checks.length)out.push(`${parts.length?`围绕英语${parts.join('、')}安排练习`:''}${parts.length&&checks.length?'，':''}${checks.length?`通过${checks.join('与')}调整教学计划`:''}${has(s,/家长/)?'，定期向家长反馈':''}。`);
        if(has(s,/新概念英语/)&&has(s,/校园测试/)&&has(s,/满分/))out.push('辅导学生在新概念英语校园测试中取得满分。');
        return unique(out);
      }
    }
    return generalBullets(rows,index<2?3:2);
  }
  function skillsFor(items){
    const source=unique(list(items).map(row=>row.replace(/\s*\n\s*/g,''))),s=source.join('\n'),out=[],used=new Set();
    const groups=[['视觉设计',['Photoshop','UI设计']],['视频制作',['Premiere','After Effects']],['三维与交互',['3ds Max','Unity']]];
    for(const [label,tools]of groups){
      const found=tools.filter(tool=>new RegExp(tool.replace(/ /g,'\\s*'),'i').test(s));
      if(found.length){out.push(label+'：'+found.join('、'));source.forEach((row,index)=>{if(found.some(tool=>new RegExp(tool.replace(/ /g,'\\s*'),'i').test(row)))used.add(index);});}
    }
    const aiSkills=[['提示词设计|结构化提示词','提示词设计'],['图像生成|AI图像|文生图','图像生成'],['图生视频','图生视频'],['多模型协作','多模型协作'],['后期整合|后期合成','后期整合']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(s)).map(([,label])=>label);
    if(aiSkills.length&&/AI|生成式|文生图|图生视频/.test(s)){out.push('AI内容制作：'+aiSkills.join('、'));source.forEach((row,index)=>{if(/AI|生成式|文生图|图生视频|提示词/.test(row))used.add(index);});}
    // Known labels can be shortened; unfamiliar tools in the same line must
    // remain visible rather than disappear as a side effect of categorization.
    const knownTools=new Set(['photoshop','ui','premiere','aftereffects','3dsmax','unity','ai']);
    source.forEach((row,index)=>{if(used.has(index)){
      const tokens=row.match(/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9+#.]*(?:\s+[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+#.]*)*/g)||[];
      if(tokens.some(token=>/[A-Za-z]/.test(token)&&!knownTools.has(token.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g,''))))used.delete(index);
    }});
    source.forEach((row,index)=>{if(!used.has(index)){const value=concise(row).replace(/[。；;]+$/,'');if(value)out.push(value);}});
    return unique(out);
  }
  function characterCount(p){return [p.headline,p.summary,...(p.education||[]).flatMap(item=>list(item.details)),...(p.experiences||[]).flatMap(item=>list(item.bullets)),...list(p.skills)].filter(Boolean).join('').replace(/\s/g,'').length;}
  function optimize(input){
    if(!input||typeof input!=='object'||Array.isArray(input))throw Error('请先上传并读取简历，再进行优化。');
    const original=clone(input),profile=clone(input),changes=[],reviewNotes=[];
    profile.education=Array.isArray(profile.education)?profile.education:[];
    profile.experiences=Array.isArray(profile.experiences)?profile.experiences:[];
    profile.skills=skillsFor(profile.skills);
    const sourceEvidence=profile.experiences.map(item=>list(item.bullets).join('\n')).join('\n');
    profile.experiences=profile.experiences.map((item,index)=>({...item,bullets:evidenceBullets(item,index,reviewNotes)}));
    profile.education=profile.education.map(item=>({...item,details:educationDetails(item,profile.experiences)}));
    const majors=profile.education.map(item=>text(item.major)).join(' ');
    const teaching=profile.experiences.some(item=>/教师|家教/.test(text(item.role)+' '+text(item.organization)));
    const media=/文生图/.test(sourceEvidence)&&/图生视频/.test(sourceEvidence);
    if(/数字媒体技术/.test(majors)&&teaching&&media){
      profile.headline='数字媒体技术背景 · 教学与AI内容实践';
      const teachingTasks=[['PPT|课件','课件制作'],['分层备课|差异化教学|按学生起点调整','分层备课'],['学生反馈|学习反馈|跟踪学习情况|错题','学习反馈']].filter(([pattern])=>new RegExp(pattern).test(sourceEvidence)).map(([,label])=>label);
      profile.summary='具有教学与AI内容项目实践。'+(teachingTasks.length?`围绕${teachingTasks.join('、')}开展教学工作。`:'')+'进行图像、视频与后期内容整合。';
    }else{
      if(profile.summary)profile.summary=generalBullets([profile.summary],2).join('');
      if(profile.headline)profile.headline=concise(profile.headline).replace(/[。；;]+$/,'');
    }
    if(/显著|明显|满意度较高|稳步提升|优秀|满分/.test(sourceEvidence))reviewNotes.push('原文中的效果与评价按本人陈述保留；投递前请核对可提供的测评、作品或反馈记录，不补造提升比例。');
    if(/AI|产品经理|FDE/i.test(text(profile.goal))&&!/产品经理|工程师/.test(profile.experiences.map(item=>text(item.role)).join(' ')))reviewNotes.push('意向岗位保留为求职目标，既有教学、制作或建模经历不改写成尚未担任过的产品或工程岗位。');
    function change(section,index,label,before,after){if(before!==after)changes.push({section,index,label,before,after});}
    change('headline',null,'简历标题',text(original.headline),text(profile.headline));
    change('summary',null,'个人简介',text(original.summary),text(profile.summary));
    profile.education.forEach((item,index)=>change('education',index,text(item.school)||`教育背景${index+1}`,list(original.education?.[index]?.details).join('\n'),list(item.details).join('\n')));
    profile.experiences.forEach((item,index)=>change('experience',index,[text(item.organization),text(item.role)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')||`经历${index+1}`,list(original.experiences?.[index]?.bullets).join('\n'),list(item.bullets).join('\n')));
    change('skills',null,'技能与证书',list(original.skills).join('\n'),profile.skills.join('\n'));
    const beforeCharacters=characterCount(original),afterCharacters=characterCount(profile);
    return {profile,changes,reviewNotes:unique(reviewNotes),stats:{beforeCharacters,afterCharacters,reductionPercent:beforeCharacters?Math.max(0,Math.round((1-afterCharacters/beforeCharacters)*100)):0,experienceCount:profile.experiences.length,bulletCountBefore:(original.experiences||[]).reduce((sum,item)=>sum+list(item.bullets).length,0),bulletCountAfter:profile.experiences.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+list(item.bullets).length,0)}};
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyResumePolish=Object.freeze({optimize});
})();

</script>
<script>
/* Local career preparation flow. No inference, networking, or access to live records. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const data = () => globalThis.CareerJourneyData;
  const courses = () => globalThis.CareerQuestLessons;
  const object = value => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
  const string = (value, limit = 4000) => typeof value === 'string' ? value.slice(0, limit) : '';
  const clone = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const cleanCopy = value => {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.replace(/固定演示|虚构课堂材料|虚构|预设|示例/g, '').replace(/本次练习/g,'本次训练');
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(cleanCopy);
    if (object(value)) return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, cleanCopy(item)]));
    return value;
  };
  const roles = () => data()?.roles || [...(data()?.rolesA || []), ...(data()?.rolesB || [])];
  const roleFor = id => roles().find(role => role.id === id) || null;
  const specialist = () => globalThis.CareerJourneyCourses;
  const lessonsFor = id => cleanCopy(specialist()?.forRole(id) || courses()?.routes?.[roleFor(id)?.route] || []);
  const evaluateLesson = (state,index,input) => {
    const custom=specialist()?.forRole(state.roleId);
    const lesson=custom?.[index];
    if(lesson?.practice&&!input)return specialist().checkPractice(lesson,state.pmProject);
    return cleanCopy(custom?specialist().evaluate(state.roleId,index,input):courses().evaluate(state.branch,index,input));
  };
  function selectCourse(state,role) {
    const prior=state.courseRoleIds[role.route];
    if (prior!==role.id && (specialist()?.forRole(role.id)||specialist()?.forRole(prior))) {
      state.completedLessons[role.route]=[];state.studiedLessons[role.route]=[];
    }
    state.courseRoleIds[role.route]=role.id;
  }
  const roundsFor = id => data()?.interviews?.[id] || [];
  const emptyInterview = (attemptNumber=1) => ({attemptNumber, index: 0, answers: [], finished: false, drafts: {}, completion:null});
  function clearSelection(state) {
    state.roleId=null;state.previewRoleId=null;state.planAcknowledged=false;state.interview=emptyInterview();state.interviewHistory=[];state.activeReportId=null;state.lessonReplay=false;state.onboardingComplete=false;state.trainingSkipped=false;
    state.lessonIndex=0;state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;state.review={type:null,index:0};
  }
  function preparationSnapshot(state) {
    const role=roleFor(state.roleId);if(!role)return null;
    return {version:1,screen:'upload',branch:role.route,roleId:role.id,previewRoleId:role.id,
      intent:clone(state.intent),planAcknowledged:state.planAcknowledged,lessonIndex:state.lessonIndex,
      completedLessons:{A:[],B:[],[role.route]:clone(state.completedLessons[role.route])},
      studiedLessons:{A:[],B:[],[role.route]:clone(state.studiedLessons[role.route])},
      courseRoleIds:{A:null,B:null,[role.route]:role.id},
      interview:clone(state.interview),interviewHistory:clone(state.interviewHistory),activeReportId:state.activeReportId,lessonReplay:state.lessonReplay,trainingSkipped:state.trainingSkipped,review:clone(state.review)};
  }
  function rememberPreparation(state) {
    const snapshot=preparationSnapshot(state);
    if(snapshot)state.savedPreparations[snapshot.roleId]=snapshot;
  }
  function restorePreparation(state,role) {
    const saved=state.savedPreparations[role.id];if(!saved)return false;
    state.completedLessons[role.route]=clone(saved.completedLessons[role.route]);
    state.studiedLessons[role.route]=clone(saved.studiedLessons[role.route]);
    state.courseRoleIds[role.route]=role.id;
    state.interview=clone(saved.interview);state.interviewHistory=clone(saved.interviewHistory||[]);state.activeReportId=saved.activeReportId||null;state.review=clone(saved.review);
    state.planAcknowledged=role.route==='A'||saved.planAcknowledged;
    state.trainingSkipped=saved.trainingSkipped;state.onboardingComplete=saved.interview.finished||state.interviewHistory.length>0;state.lessonReplay=saved.lessonReplay===true;
    state.lessonIndex=saved.lessonIndex;state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;
    return true;
  }
  const fresh = () => ({version: 1, screen: 'upload', profile: null, upload: {name: ''}, confirmed: false, resumePolish:null, resumeView:'original', careerPreferences:null, preferenceDraft:null,
    branch: null, roleId: null, previewRoleId: null, intent: {goal: '', deadline: '', hoursPerWeek: 6, today: '', days: 0},
    completedLessons: {A: [], B: []}, studiedLessons: {A: [], B: []}, courseRoleIds: {A:null,B:null}, savedPreparations: {}, trainingSkipped: false, lessonIndex: 0, lessonInput: '', lessonFeedback: null, pmProject:null,
    interview: emptyInterview(), interviewHistory:[], activeReportId:null, lessonReplay:false, planAcknowledged: false, onboardingComplete: false, review: {type: null, index: 0}, textSize: 'standard', error: null});

  function photoFor(raw){
    if(!object(raw)||typeof raw.dataUrl!=='string'||raw.dataUrl.length>512000||!/^data:image\/jpeg;base64,\/9j\/[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(raw.dataUrl))return null;
    const width=Number(raw.width),height=Number(raw.height);
    return Number.isInteger(width)&&Number.isInteger(height)&&width>0&&height>0&&width<=2048&&height<=2048?{dataUrl:raw.dataUrl,width,height}:null;
  }

  function profileFor(raw) {
    if (!object(raw) || (!string(raw.name,80).trim()&&!string(raw.sourceText,30000).trim())) return null;
    const profile = {name:string(raw.name,80)};
    const photo=photoFor(raw.photo);if(photo)profile.photo=photo;
    for (const key of ['name','headline','email','phone','location','summary','goal','sourceName','sourceText']) {
      if (typeof raw[key] === 'string') profile[key] = string(raw[key], key === 'sourceText' ? 30000 : 4000);
    }
    profile.skills = Array.isArray(raw.skills) ? raw.skills.slice(0, 40).filter(item => typeof item === 'string').map(item => string(item, 300)) : [];
    profile.education = Array.isArray(raw.education) ? raw.education.slice(0, 12).filter(object).map(item => ({school:string(item.school,200),degree:string(item.degree,100),major:string(item.major,200),period:string(item.period,100),details:Array.isArray(item.details)?item.details.slice(0,12).map(value=>string(value,600)):[]})) : [];
    profile.experiences = Array.isArray(raw.experiences) ? raw.experiences.slice(0, 20).filter(object).map(item => ({organization:string(item.organization,200),role:string(item.role,200),period:string(item.period,100),bullets:Array.isArray(item.bullets)?item.bullets.slice(0,20).map(value=>string(value,1000)):[]})) : [];
    if(typeof raw.extractionMethod==='string')profile.extractionMethod=string(raw.extractionMethod,120);
    if(Array.isArray(raw.extractionWarnings))profile.extractionWarnings=raw.extractionWarnings.slice(0,20).filter(item=>typeof item==='string').map(item=>string(item,600));
    if (Number.isFinite(raw.hoursPerWeek)) profile.hoursPerWeek = Math.max(1, Math.min(40, raw.hoursPerWeek));
    return profile;
  }
  function polishFor(raw) {
    if(!object(raw))return null;
    const original=profileFor(raw.original),draft=profileFor(raw.draft);
    if(!original||!draft)return null;
    draft.sourceText=original.sourceText;
    const changes=(Array.isArray(raw.changes)?raw.changes:[]).slice(0,40).filter(object).map(item=>({section:string(item.section,80),index:Number.isInteger(item.index)?item.index:0,label:string(item.label,180),before:string(item.before,6000),after:string(item.after,6000)}));
    const stats={};for(const key of ['beforeCharacters','afterCharacters','reductionPercent','experienceCount','bulletCountBefore','bulletCountAfter'])stats[key]=Number.isFinite(raw.stats?.[key])?Math.max(0,raw.stats[key]):0;
    return {original,draft,changes,stats,reviewNotes:(Array.isArray(raw.reviewNotes)?raw.reviewNotes:[]).filter(item=>typeof item==='string').slice(0,12).map(item=>string(item,800)),applied:raw.applied===true,manuallyEdited:raw.manuallyEdited===true};
  }
  const preferences=()=>globalThis.CareerJourneyPreferences;
  const needsPreferences=state=>Boolean(preferences()&&!state.careerPreferences?.confirmed);
  function dayNumber(date) {
    if (typeof date !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) return null;
    const stamp = Date.parse(date + 'T00:00:00Z');
    return Number.isFinite(stamp) && new Date(stamp).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === date ? stamp / 86400000 : null;
  }
  function intentFor(raw) {
    const value = {goal: string(raw?.goal, 100).trim(), deadline:string(raw?.deadline,10), hoursPerWeek:Number(raw?.hoursPerWeek), today:string(raw?.today,10), days:0};
    const start=dayNumber(value.today), end=dayNumber(value.deadline);
    if (!value.goal || start === null || end === null || end <= start || end-start > 366 || !Number.isFinite(value.hoursPerWeek) || value.hoursPerWeek < 1 || value.hoursPerWeek > 40) return null;
    value.days=end-start; return value;
  }
  const completed = state => state.completedLessons[roleFor(state.roleId)?.route] || [];
  const trainingDone = state => roleFor(state.roleId)?.route === state.branch && (state.branch !== 'B' || state.planAcknowledged === true) && lessonsFor(state.roleId).length > 0 && completed(state).length === lessonsFor(state.roleId).length;
  const canInterview = state => Boolean(state.profile && state.confirmed && roleFor(state.roleId)?.route === state.branch && (state.branch !== 'B' || intentFor(state.intent)));
  const lessonStudied = (state, index = state.lessonIndex) => {
    const lesson=lessonsFor(state.roleId)[index];
    return Boolean(lesson && (completed(state).includes(lesson.id) || state.studiedLessons?.[state.branch]?.includes(lesson.id)));
  };
  const interviewScreenFor = state => state.interview.finished ? 'finish' : state.interview.answers[state.interview.index] ? 'feedback' : 'interview';
  const directionScreenFor = state => needsPreferences(state)?'preferences':state.roleId ? (state.branch==='B'?'intent':'roles') : 'paths';
  function onboardingSteps(state) {
    const ready=canInterview(state), skipped=Boolean(ready&&state.trainingSkipped&&!trainingDone(state));
    const done=[Boolean(state.profile),Boolean(state.profile&&state.confirmed),ready,Boolean(trainingDone(state)||skipped),Boolean(ready&&(state.interview.finished||state.interviewHistory.length))];
    const current=done.findIndex(value=>!value);
    return ['上传简历','确认个人信息','选择岗位方向','岗位学习','模拟面试与报告'].map((title,index)=>({id:index+1,title,status:done[index]?'done':index===current||(index===4&&ready)?'current':'locked',skipped:index===3&&skipped}));
  }
  function canOpenLesson(state, index) {
    return state.confirmed && Boolean(state.profile) && roleFor(state.roleId)?.route === state.branch && (state.branch !== 'B' || state.planAcknowledged) &&
      Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 && index < lessonsFor(state.roleId).length && index <= completed(state).length;
  }
  function planFor(state) {
    const role=roleFor(state.roleId), intent=intentFor(state.intent);
    return state.branch === 'B' && role?.route === 'B' && intent && data()?.createPlan ? data().createPlan({targetRoleId:role.id, days:intent.days, hoursPerWeek:intent.hoursPerWeek}) : null;
  }
  function askedRoundFor(raw,original) {
    if(!object(raw)||!original||raw.id!==original.id||raw.kind!==original.kind||typeof raw.question!=='string'||!raw.question.trim()||typeof raw.suggestedAnswer!=='string'||!object(raw.feedback))return null;
    if(!['keep','improve','nextTry'].every(key=>typeof raw.feedback[key]==='string'))return null;
    return {id:original.id,kind:original.kind,question:string(raw.question,1600),suggestedAnswer:string(raw.suggestedAnswer,1600),
      ...(raw.source==='refund-project'?{source:'refund-project'}:{}),
      feedback:{keep:string(raw.feedback.keep,800),improve:string(raw.feedback.improve,800),nextTry:string(raw.feedback.nextTry,800)}};
  }
  function roundFor(state, index = state.interview.index) {
    const original=roundsFor(state.roleId)[index];
    if (!original) return null;
    const answer=state.interview?.answers?.[index];
    const asked=answer?.roundId===original.id?askedRoundFor(answer.askedRound,original):null;
    if(asked)return {...asked,topic:original.topic};
    const projectReady=state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'&&specialist()?.evidence(state.pmProject)?.tests.length>0;
    const firstAnswer=state.interview?.answers?.[0];
    const projectFirst=state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'&&(firstAnswer?firstAnswer.askedRound?.source==='refund-project':projectReady);
    const round=clone(projectFirst&&index>=2&&index<4?roundsFor(state.roleId)[index-2]:original);
    round.id=original.id;round.kind=original.kind;round.topic=original.topic;
    // A curated follow-up may refer to an uploaded experience only when its
    // supporting phrases occur in that resume. Intent fields are not evidence.
    const p=state.profile||{};
    const evidence=[p.headline,p.summary,...(p.education||[]).flatMap(item=>[item.school,item.major,...(item.details||[])]),...(p.experiences||[]).flatMap(item=>[item.organization,item.role,...(item.bullets||[])]),...(p.skills||[])].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    const anchor=round.resumeAnchors?.find(item=>item.keywords?.length&&item.keywords.every(word=>evidence.includes(word)));
    if(anchor){round.question=anchor.question;if(anchor.suggestedAnswer)round.suggestedAnswer=anchor.suggestedAnswer;}
    if(projectReady){
      const projectIndex=projectFirst?(index<2?index+2:-1):index;
      const fromProject=specialist()?.projectRound(projectIndex,state.pmProject);
      if(fromProject)Object.assign(round,fromProject,{source:'refund-project'});
    }
    delete round.resumeAnchors;
    const plan=planFor(state), hours=Number.isFinite(plan?.totalHours)?String(plan.totalHours):null;
    const render=value=>{
      if (typeof value==='string') return hours===null
        ? value.replace('计划投入约{planHours}小时准备','准备时间也有限').replace('计划投入的约{planHours}小时','有限的准备时间').replaceAll('{planHours}','有限的准备时间')
        : value.replaceAll('{planHours}',hours);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(render);
      if (object(value)) return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key,item])=>[key,render(item)]));
      return value;
    };
    return render(round);
  }
  const attemptNumberFor=value=>Number.isSafeInteger(value)&&value>=1&&value<=1000000?value:1;
  const attemptId=(roleId,number)=>roleId+'-attempt-'+number;
  function lessonIdsFor(raw,roleId) {
    const result=[],list=lessonsFor(roleId);if(!Array.isArray(raw))return result;
    for(let index=0;index<list.length&&raw[index]===list[index].id;index++)result.push(list[index].id);
    return result;
  }
  function completionFor(raw,state) {
    const role=roleFor(state.roleId);if(!role)return null;
    const source=object(raw)?raw:{};
    const storedIntent=intentFor(source.intent);
    const intent=role.route==='B'?(storedIntent?.goal===role.title?storedIntent:intentFor(state.intent)):clone(state.intent);
    return {profileName:string(source.profileName,80)||state.profile.name,intent,
      lessonIds:lessonIdsFor(Array.isArray(source.lessonIds)?source.lessonIds:completed(state),role.id),
      studiedLessonIds:[...new Set((Array.isArray(source.studiedLessonIds)?source.studiedLessonIds:state.studiedLessons[role.route]).filter(id=>lessonsFor(role.id).some(lesson=>lesson.id===id)))].slice(0,lessonsFor(role.id).length)};
  }
  function completedReport(state) {
    if(!state.interview.finished)return null;
    const meta=completionFor(state.interview.completion,state);
    const answers=state.interview.answers.map((answer,index)=>({...clone(answer),askedRound:askedRoundFor(roundFor(state,index),roundsFor(state.roleId)[index])}));
    return {id:attemptId(state.roleId,state.interview.attemptNumber),roleId:state.roleId,attemptNumber:state.interview.attemptNumber,...meta,answers};
  }
  function historyFor(raw,state) {
    const role=roleFor(state.roleId);if(!role||!Array.isArray(raw))return [];
    const rounds=roundsFor(role.id),result=[],seen=new Set();
    for(const item of raw.slice(0,12)){
      if(!object(item)||item.roleId!==role.id||attemptNumberFor(item.attemptNumber)!==item.attemptNumber||item.id!==attemptId(role.id,item.attemptNumber)||seen.has(item.id)||!Array.isArray(item.answers)||item.answers.length!==rounds.length)continue;
      const answers=[];
      for(let i=0;i<rounds.length;i++){
        const answer=item.answers[i],askedRound=askedRoundFor(answer?.askedRound,rounds[i]);
        if(!object(answer)||answer.roundId!==rounds[i].id||!string(answer.text).trim()||!['text','voice'].includes(answer.mode)||!askedRound)break;
        answers.push({roundId:rounds[i].id,text:string(answer.text),mode:answer.mode,askedRound});
      }
      if(answers.length!==rounds.length)continue;
      const intent=role.route==='B'?intentFor(item.intent):clone(state.intent);if(role.route==='B'&&(!intent||intent.goal!==role.title))continue;
      result.push({id:item.id,roleId:role.id,attemptNumber:item.attemptNumber,profileName:string(item.profileName,80)||state.profile.name,intent,
        lessonIds:lessonIdsFor(item.lessonIds,role.id),studiedLessonIds:[...new Set((Array.isArray(item.studiedLessonIds)?item.studiedLessonIds:[]).filter(id=>lessonsFor(role.id).some(lesson=>lesson.id===id)))].slice(0,lessonsFor(role.id).length),answers});
      seen.add(item.id);
    }
    return result.sort((a,b)=>b.attemptNumber-a.attemptNumber).slice(0,3);
  }
  function reportsFromState(state){
    const current=completedReport(state);
    return [current,...state.interviewHistory].filter(Boolean).filter((item,index,items)=>items.findIndex(other=>other.id===item.id)===index).sort((a,b)=>b.attemptNumber-a.attemptNumber);
  }
  function reportsFor(raw){
    const state=normalize(raw);
    return reportsFromState(state).map(item=>({id:item.id,attemptNumber:item.attemptNumber,current:item.id===attemptId(state.roleId,state.interview.attemptNumber),answerCount:item.answers.length,completedLessonCount:item.lessonIds.length}));
  }
  function reportState(raw,reportId){
    const state=normalize(raw),reports=reportsFromState(state),selected=reports.find(item=>item.id===(reportId||state.activeReportId))||((state.interview.finished||state.screen==='finish')?reports[0]:null);
    if(!selected)return state;
    const view=clone(state);view.activeReportId=selected.id;view.screen='finish';view.profile.name=selected.profileName;
    view.intent=clone(selected.intent);view.completedLessons[view.branch]=clone(selected.lessonIds);view.studiedLessons[view.branch]=clone(selected.studiedLessonIds);
    view.interview={attemptNumber:selected.attemptNumber,index:selected.answers.length-1,answers:clone(selected.answers),finished:true,drafts:{},completion:completionFor(selected,state)};
    view.planAcknowledged=true;view.trainingSkipped=!trainingDone(view);view.onboardingComplete=true;
    return view;
  }
  function lessonInputFor(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.slice(0, 300);
    if (object(value) && Array.isArray(value.removed)) return {removed:[...new Set(value.removed.filter(id => typeof id === 'string' && courses()?.rawRows?.some(row => row.id === id)))]};
    return '';
  }
  function normalize(raw, {includeSaved=true}={}) {
    const state=fresh();
    if (!object(raw) || raw.version !== 1) return state;
    state.textSize=raw.textSize === 'large' ? 'large' : 'standard';
    state.profile=profileFor(raw.profile);
    if (!state.profile) {if(raw.screen==='import')state.screen='import';return state;}
    state.upload={name:string(raw.upload?.name, 240)}; state.screen='upload'; state.confirmed=raw.confirmed === true;
    state.pmProject=specialist()?.normalizeProject(raw.pmProject)||null;
    state.resumePolish=polishFor(raw.resumePolish);state.resumeView=state.resumePolish&&raw.resumeView==='polished'?'polished':'original';
    state.careerPreferences=preferences()?.normalize(raw.careerPreferences)||null;
    if(object(raw.preferenceDraft))state.preferenceDraft={goals:string(raw.preferenceDraft.goals,260),deadline:string(raw.preferenceDraft.deadline,10),hoursPerWeek:string(String(raw.preferenceDraft.hoursPerWeek??''),20)};
    state.intent.goal=string(state.profile.goal,100);
    if (!state.confirmed) {if(['import','resume','compare'].includes(raw.screen))state.screen=raw.screen;return state;}
    state.intent=intentFor(raw.intent) || {...state.intent,goal:string(state.profile.goal,100)};
    if(includeSaved&&object(raw.savedPreparations))for(const role of roles()){
      const saved=raw.savedPreparations[role.id];
      if(!object(saved)||saved.roleId!==role.id||saved.branch!==role.route||role.route==='B'&&saved.intent?.goal!==role.title)continue;
      const checked=normalize({...saved,profile:state.profile,confirmed:true,careerPreferences:state.careerPreferences},{includeSaved:false});
      if(checked.roleId===role.id)state.savedPreparations[role.id]=preparationSnapshot(checked);
    }
    for (const route of ['A','B']) {
      const current=roleFor(raw.roleId);
      const scope=current?.route===route?current:roleFor(raw.courseRoleIds?.[route]);
      state.courseRoleIds[route]=scope?.route===route?scope.id:null;
      const course=state.courseRoleIds[route]?lessonsFor(state.courseRoleIds[route]):courses()?.routes?.[route] || [], saved=raw.completedLessons?.[route];
      if (Array.isArray(saved)) for (let i=0;i<course.length && saved[i]===course[i].id;i++) state.completedLessons[route].push(course[i].id);
      const studied=Array.isArray(raw.studiedLessons?.[route])?raw.studiedLessons[route]:[];
      state.studiedLessons[route]=course.slice(0,state.completedLessons[route].length+1).filter(lesson=>state.completedLessons[route].includes(lesson.id)||studied.includes(lesson.id)).map(lesson=>lesson.id);
    }
    if (['A','B'].includes(raw.branch)) state.branch=raw.branch;
    const preview=roleFor(raw.previewRoleId);
    if (preview?.route === state.branch) state.previewRoleId=preview.id;
    const selected=roleFor(raw.roleId);
    if (selected?.route === state.branch && (state.branch !== 'B' || intentFor(raw.intent))) {
      state.roleId=selected.id;
      state.planAcknowledged=state.branch === 'A' || raw.planAcknowledged === true;
      const index=raw.lessonIndex;
      if (canOpenLesson(state,index)) {
        state.lessonIndex=index;
        if(lessonStudied(state,index)){
          state.lessonInput=lessonInputFor(raw.lessonInput);
          if (raw.lessonFeedback) state.lessonFeedback=evaluateLesson(state,index,state.lessonInput);
        }
      }
      if (canInterview(state)) {
        const rounds=roundsFor(state.roleId), saved=raw.interview;
        state.interview.attemptNumber=attemptNumberFor(saved?.attemptNumber);
        if (Array.isArray(saved?.answers)) for (let i=0;i<rounds.length && i<saved.answers.length;i++) {
          const answer=saved.answers[i];
          if (!object(answer) || answer.roundId !== rounds[i].id || !string(answer.text).trim() || !['text','voice'].includes(answer.mode)) break;
          const askedRound=askedRoundFor(answer.askedRound,rounds[i]);
          state.interview.answers.push({roundId:rounds[i].id,text:string(answer.text),mode:answer.mode,...(askedRound?{askedRound}:{})});
        }
        const count=state.interview.answers.length;
        state.interview.index=Math.min(count,Math.max(0,rounds.length-1));
        if (count && saved.index === count-1) state.interview.index=count-1;
        state.interview.finished=saved?.finished === true && count === rounds.length && rounds.length > 0;
        if(state.interview.finished)state.interview.completion=completionFor(saved?.completion,state);
        if (object(saved?.drafts)) {
          const answered=new Set(state.interview.answers.map(answer=>answer.roundId));
          for (const round of rounds) if (!answered.has(round.id) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(saved.drafts,round.id) && typeof saved.drafts[round.id] === 'string') {
            state.interview.drafts[round.id]=string(saved.drafts[round.id]);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    state.interviewHistory=historyFor(raw.interviewHistory,state);
    if(state.interviewHistory.some(item=>item.attemptNumber>=state.interview.attemptNumber)&&!state.interview.finished)state.interview.attemptNumber=Math.min(1000000,Math.max(...state.interviewHistory.map(item=>item.attemptNumber))+1);
    const availableReports=reportsFromState(state);
    state.activeReportId=availableReports.some(item=>item.id===raw.activeReportId)?raw.activeReportId:null;
    state.lessonReplay=raw.lessonReplay===true&&canOpenLesson(state,state.lessonIndex)&&completed(state).includes(lessonsFor(state.roleId)[state.lessonIndex]?.id);
    state.trainingSkipped=canInterview(state)&&!trainingDone(state)&&(raw.trainingSkipped===true||state.interview.answers.length>0||['interview','feedback'].includes(raw.screen)||state.interview.finished);
    // Finishing the interview opens the continuing workspace automatically.
    state.onboardingComplete=state.interview.finished||state.interviewHistory.length>0;
    const allowed=['upload','import','resume','compare','paths','preferences'];
    if (allowed.includes(raw.screen)) state.screen=raw.screen;
    if (raw.screen === 'intent' && state.branch === 'B') state.screen='intent';
    if (raw.screen === 'roles' && state.branch) state.screen=state.branch==='B'?'intent':'roles';
    if (raw.screen === 'role' && state.previewRoleId) state.screen='role';
    if (raw.screen === 'plan' && planFor(state)) state.screen='plan';
    if (raw.screen === 'learning' && state.roleId) state.screen='learning';
    if (raw.screen === 'learn' && canOpenLesson(state,raw.lessonIndex)) state.screen='learn';
    if (raw.screen === 'interview' && canInterview(state) && !state.interview.finished) state.screen=state.interview.answers[state.interview.index]?'feedback':'interview';
    if (raw.screen === 'feedback' && state.interview.answers.length && state.interview.answers[state.interview.index]?.roundId === roundFor(state)?.id) state.screen='feedback';
    if (raw.screen === 'finish' && availableReports.length) state.screen='finish';
    if (raw.screen === 'practice' && canInterview(state)) state.screen='practice';
    if (raw.screen === 'interviewReady' && canInterview(state)) state.screen='interviewReady';
    if (state.roleId && raw.review?.type === 'lesson' && Number.isInteger(raw.review.index) && raw.review.index >= 0 && raw.review.index < completed(state).length) state.review={type:'lesson',index:raw.review.index};
    if (state.roleId && raw.review?.type === 'interview' && Number.isInteger(raw.review.index) && raw.review.index >= 0 && raw.review.index < state.interview.answers.length) state.review={type:'interview',index:raw.review.index};
    if (raw.screen === 'review' && state.roleId) {
      state.screen='review';
    }
    return state;
  }
  function reduce(raw, action) {
    const state=normalize(raw);
    if (!object(action)) return state;
    if (action.type === 'RESET') return {...fresh(),textSize:state.textSize};
    if (action.type === 'SET_TEXT_SIZE') {state.textSize=action.textSize === 'large'?'large':'standard';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_HOME') {state.screen='upload';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'OPEN_ONBOARDING_STEP') {
      const step=onboardingSteps(state).find(item=>item.id===action.index);
      if(!step||step.status==='locked')return state;
      if(step.id===1)state.screen='import';
      if(step.id===2)state.screen='resume';
      if(step.id===3)state.screen=directionScreenFor(state);
      if(step.id===4){
        state.screen=state.branch==='B'&&!state.planAcknowledged?'plan':'learn';
        state.lessonIndex=Math.min(completed(state).length,Math.max(0,lessonsFor(state.roleId).length-1));state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;
      }
      if(step.id===5){state.trainingSkipped=!trainingDone(state);state.screen=interviewScreenFor(state);}
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'COMPLETE_ONBOARDING') {
      if(state.interview.finished&&canInterview(state)){state.onboardingComplete=true;state.screen='upload';}
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'IMPORT_PROFILE') {
      const profile=profileFor(action.profile);
      if (!profile) return {...state,error:'简历没有可读取的内容，请重新选择文件。'};
      return {...fresh(),profile,upload:{name:string(action.fileName,240)},screen:'upload',textSize:state.textSize,intent:{...fresh().intent,goal:string(profile.goal,100)}};
    }
    if (!state.profile) return state;
    if(action.type==='SET_RESUME_PHOTO'){
      const photo=photoFor(action.photo);
      if(!photo)return {...state,error:'这张照片未能读取，请选择JPG、PNG或WebP照片重试。'};
      state.profile.photo=clone(photo);
      if(state.resumePolish){state.resumePolish.original.photo=clone(photo);state.resumePolish.draft.photo=clone(photo);}
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'EDIT_PROFILE') {
      const profile=profileFor(action.profile);
      if (!profile) return {...state,error:'简历内容不能为空，请重新核对。'};
      // A changed resume retracts the old decisions and their downstream answers.
      return {...fresh(),profile,upload:clone(state.upload),screen:'resume',textSize:state.textSize,intent:{...fresh().intent,goal:string(profile.goal,100)}};
    }
    if (action.type === 'OPTIMIZE_RESUME') {
      const optimizer=globalThis.CareerJourneyResumePolish;
      if(!optimizer)return {...state,error:'简历优化工具尚未加载，请刷新后重试。'};
      if(!state.resumePolish){const result=optimizer.optimize(clone(state.profile));state.resumePolish=polishFor({original:state.profile,draft:result.profile,changes:result.changes,reviewNotes:result.reviewNotes,stats:result.stats,applied:false});}
      state.resumeView='polished';state.screen='resume';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_ORIGINAL_RESUME') {state.resumeView='original';state.screen='resume';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_POLISHED_RESUME'&&state.resumePolish) {state.resumeView='polished';state.screen='resume';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'EDIT_POLISHED_RESUME'&&state.resumePolish) {
      const draft=profileFor(action.profile);if(!draft)return {...state,error:'简历内容不能为空。'};
      draft.sourceText=state.resumePolish.original.sourceText;state.resumePolish.draft=draft;state.resumePolish.applied=false;state.resumePolish.manuallyEdited=true;state.resumeView='polished';state.screen='resume';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'APPLY_POLISHED_RESUME'&&state.resumePolish) {state.profile=clone(state.resumePolish.draft);state.resumePolish.applied=true;state.resumeView='polished';state.screen='resume';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'RESTORE_ORIGINAL_RESUME'&&state.resumePolish) {state.profile=clone(state.resumePolish.original);state.resumePolish=null;state.resumeView='original';state.screen='resume';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'CONFIRM_RESUME') {if(!state.profile.name.trim())return {...state,error:'请先补充姓名，再确认这份简历。'};state.confirmed=true;state.screen=needsPreferences(state)?'preferences':'upload';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_RESUME') {state.screen='resume';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_RESUME_COMPARE') {state.screen='compare';return state;}
    if (!state.confirmed) return state;
    if (action.type === 'EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES') {state.screen='preferences';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SAVE_CAREER_PREFERENCES') {
      const value=preferences()?.normalize(action);
      if(!value)return {...state,screen:'preferences',preferenceDraft:{goals:Array.isArray(action.goals)?action.goals.join('、'):string(action.goals,260),deadline:string(action.deadline,10),hoursPerWeek:string(String(action.hoursPerWeek??''),20)},error:'请填写1—3个意向岗位、未来一年的准备日期，以及每周1—40小时的时间。'};
      const available=preferences().supportedRoles(value,data().rolesB);
      if(state.branch==='B'&&state.roleId&&!available.some(item=>item.id===state.roleId)){rememberPreparation(state);clearSelection(state);state.branch=null;}
      const preferred=available.find(item=>item.id===state.roleId)||available[0];
      state.careerPreferences=value;state.preferenceDraft=null;state.intent={goal:preferred?.title||'',deadline:value.deadline,hoursPerWeek:value.hoursPerWeek,today:value.today,days:dayNumber(value.deadline)-dayNumber(value.today)};state.screen='paths';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'GO_PATHS') {state.screen='paths';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_DIRECTION') {state.screen=directionScreenFor(state);return state;}
    if (action.type === 'EDIT_INTENT' && state.branch === 'B') {state.screen='intent';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'CHOOSE_A' || action.type === 'CHOOSE_B') {
      if(needsPreferences(state)){state.screen='preferences';return state;}
      const branch=action.type === 'CHOOSE_A'?'A':'B';
      if (state.branch !== branch) {rememberPreparation(state);clearSelection(state);}
      state.branch=branch;state.screen=branch==='A'?'roles':'intent';
      if(branch==='B'&&preferences()){
        const available=preferences().supportedRoles(state.careerPreferences,data().rolesB);
        if(available.length===1){const selected=available[0],sameRole=state.roleId===selected.id;selectCourse(state,selected);state.roleId=selected.id;state.previewRoleId=selected.id;if(!sameRole)restorePreparation(state,selected);state.intent={...state.intent,goal:selected.title};state.screen='plan';}
      }
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'SAVE_INTENT' && state.branch === 'B') {
      const intent=intentFor(action), selectedRole=roles().find(role=>role.route==='B'&&role.title===intent?.goal);
      if(preferences()&&(!state.careerPreferences||!preferences().supportedRoles(state.careerPreferences,data().rolesB).some(role=>role.id===selectedRole?.id)))return {...state,error:'请先在求职意向中填写这个目标岗位。',screen:'preferences'};
      if (!intent || !selectedRole) return {...state,error:'请选择支持的意向岗位、未来一年的求职日期，以及每周1—40小时的准备时间。'};
      // The form already names an exact target. Choose it once and show its plan;
      // changing its timetable does not erase an interview or completed learning.
      const changingRole=state.roleId!==selectedRole.id;
      if(changingRole){rememberPreparation(state);clearSelection(state);}
      selectCourse(state,selectedRole);
      if(state.careerPreferences)state.careerPreferences={...state.careerPreferences,deadline:intent.deadline,today:intent.today,hoursPerWeek:intent.hoursPerWeek};
      state.intent=intent;state.roleId=selectedRole.id;state.previewRoleId=selectedRole.id;if(changingRole)restorePreparation(state,selectedRole);state.screen='plan';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'BACK_ROLES' && state.branch) {state.screen=state.branch==='B'?'intent':'roles';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'OPEN_ROLE') {
      const role=roleFor(action.roleId);
      if (role?.route===state.branch && (state.branch!=='B'||intentFor(state.intent))) {state.previewRoleId=role.id;state.screen='role';}
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'CHOOSE_ROLE') {
      const role=roleFor(action.roleId||state.previewRoleId);
      if (!role || role.route!==state.branch || (state.branch==='B'&&!intentFor(state.intent))) return state;
      const sameRole=state.roleId===role.id;
      if (!sameRole) {rememberPreparation(state);state.interview=emptyInterview();state.interviewHistory=[];state.activeReportId=null;state.lessonReplay=false;state.review={type:null,index:0};state.onboardingComplete=false;state.trainingSkipped=false;}
      selectCourse(state,role);
      state.roleId=role.id;state.previewRoleId=role.id;state.lessonIndex=state.branch==='B'?0:Math.min(completed(state).length,Math.max(0,lessonsFor(role.id).length-1));state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;
      state.planAcknowledged=state.branch==='A'||(sameRole&&state.planAcknowledged);if(!sameRole)restorePreparation(state,role);state.screen='upload';return state;
    }
    if (!state.roleId) return state;
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_LEARNING_RECORDS') {state.screen='learning';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_PLAN' && planFor(state)) {state.screen='plan';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER' && canInterview(state)) {state.planAcknowledged=true;state.screen='practice';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE' && canInterview(state)) {state.screen='interviewReady';return state;}
    if (action.type === 'RESTART_LESSON' && canOpenLesson(state,action.index)) {
      state.lessonIndex=action.index;state.lessonReplay=completed(state).includes(lessonsFor(state.roleId)[action.index].id);state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;state.screen='learn';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'START_NEW_INTERVIEW' && canInterview(state)) {
      if(state.interview.finished){
        const saved=completedReport(state);state.interviewHistory=[saved,...state.interviewHistory.filter(item=>item.id!==saved.id)].slice(0,3);
        state.interview=emptyInterview(Math.min(1000000,Math.max(saved.attemptNumber,...state.interviewHistory.map(item=>item.attemptNumber))+1));
      }
      state.activeReportId=null;state.trainingSkipped=!trainingDone(state);state.screen=interviewScreenFor(state);state.onboardingComplete=state.interviewHistory.length>0;return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'VIEW_REPORT' && canInterview(state)) {
      const report=reportsFromState(state).find(item=>item.id===action.reportId);
      if(report){state.activeReportId=report.id;state.screen='finish';}return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'START_LEARNING') {
      state.planAcknowledged=true;state.lessonReplay=false;state.screen='learn';state.lessonIndex=Math.min(completed(state).length,lessonsFor(state.roleId).length-1);state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'OPEN_LESSON' && canOpenLesson(state,action.index)) {state.lessonReplay=false;state.lessonIndex=action.index;state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;state.screen='learn';return state;}
    if (['ACK_LESSON','START_PRACTICE'].includes(action.type) && state.screen==='learn' && canOpenLesson(state,state.lessonIndex)) {
      const lesson=lessonsFor(state.roleId)[state.lessonIndex];
      if(!lessonStudied(state)){state.studiedLessons[state.branch].push(lesson.id);state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;}
      return state;
    }
    if (['SET_PM_PROJECT','PM_USE_PROMPT_EXAMPLE','PM_BUILD','PM_RUN_CASE','PM_EDIT'].includes(action.type)&&state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'&&state.screen==='learn'&&lessonStudied(state)) {
      const lesson=specialist()?.forRole(state.roleId)?.[state.lessonIndex];
      if(!lesson?.practice||!specialist().canEditPractice(lesson,action))return state;
      if(action.type==='PM_EDIT'){state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;return state;}
      if(state.lessonFeedback?.correct&&action.type!=='PM_RUN_CASE')return state;
      const checked=state.lessonFeedback?.correct;
      state.pmProject=specialist().updateProject(state.pmProject,action);state.lessonInput='';
      state.lessonFeedback=checked?specialist().checkPractice(lesson,state.pmProject):null;
      return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'SET_LESSON_INPUT' && state.screen==='learn' && lessonStudied(state)) {state.lessonInput=lessonInputFor(action.value);state.lessonFeedback=null;return state;}
    if (action.type === 'CHECK_LESSON' && state.screen==='learn' && lessonStudied(state)) {state.lessonFeedback=evaluateLesson(state,state.lessonIndex,state.lessonInput);return state;}
    if (action.type === 'COMPLETE_LESSON' && state.screen==='learn' && lessonStudied(state) && state.lessonFeedback?.correct) {
      const list=completed(state),lesson=lessonsFor(state.roleId)[state.lessonIndex];if (list.length===state.lessonIndex) list.push(lesson.id);if(trainingDone(state))state.trainingSkipped=false;return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'NEXT_LESSON' && state.screen==='learn' && completed(state).includes(lessonsFor(state.roleId)[state.lessonIndex]?.id)) {
      if(state.lessonReplay){if(state.lessonFeedback?.correct){state.lessonReplay=false;state.screen='practice';state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;}return state;}
      if (canOpenLesson(state,state.lessonIndex+1)) {state.lessonIndex++;state.lessonInput='';state.lessonFeedback=null;}
      else if (trainingDone(state)) state.screen='upload';return state;
    }
    if (['START_INTERVIEW','SKIP_TRAINING'].includes(action.type) && canInterview(state)) {state.activeReportId=null;state.trainingSkipped=!trainingDone(state);state.screen=interviewScreenFor(state);return state;}
    if (action.type === 'SET_ANSWER_DRAFT' && state.screen==='interview' && canInterview(state) && !state.interview.finished) {
      const round=roundFor(state);
      if (!round || state.interview.answers.length!==state.interview.index || typeof action.text!=='string' || (action.roundId!==undefined && action.roundId!==round.id)) return state;
      state.interview.drafts[round.id]=string(action.text);return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'SUBMIT_ANSWER' && state.screen==='interview' && canInterview(state) && !state.interview.finished) {
      const text=string(action.text),round=roundFor(state);
      if (!text.trim()) return {...state,error:'先写下或说出你的回答，再继续。'};
      if (state.interview.answers.length!==state.interview.index || !round) return state;
      const askedRound=askedRoundFor(round,round);
      state.interview.answers.push({roundId:round.id,text,mode:action.mode==='voice'?'voice':'text',...(askedRound?{askedRound}:{})});delete state.interview.drafts[round.id];state.screen='feedback';return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'NEXT_QUESTION' && state.screen==='feedback') {
      if (state.interview.index===roundsFor(state.roleId).length-1) {state.interview.finished=true;state.interview.completion=completionFor(null,state);state.activeReportId=null;state.onboardingComplete=true;state.screen='finish';}
      else {state.interview.index++;state.screen='interview';}return state;
    }
    if (action.type === 'SHOW_REVIEW') {state.activeReportId=null;state.screen='review';state.review={type:null,index:0};return state;}
    if (action.type === 'REVIEW_LESSON' && Number.isInteger(action.index) && action.index>=0 && action.index<completed(state).length) {state.activeReportId=null;state.screen='review';state.review={type:'lesson',index:action.index};return state;}
    if (action.type === 'REVIEW_INTERVIEW' && Number.isInteger(action.index) && action.index>=0 && action.index<state.interview.answers.length) {state.activeReportId=null;state.screen='review';state.review={type:'interview',index:action.index};return state;}
    if (action.type === 'BACK_FINISH' && reportsFromState(state).length) {state.activeReportId=state.interview.finished?attemptId(state.roleId,state.interview.attemptNumber):reportsFromState(state)[0].id;state.screen='finish';return state;}
    return state;
  }
  function reportText(raw) {
    const state=reportState(raw),role=roleFor(state.roleId);
    if (!role) return '';
    return ['RoleReady｜求职准备记录',`${state.profile.name} · ${role.title}`,`第${state.interview.attemptNumber||1}次面试${state.interview.finished?'报告':'记录'}`,`准备路径：${state.branch==='A'?'基于现有经历':'意向岗位学习'}`,
      ...(state.branch==='B'?[`求职日期：${state.intent.deadline}；每周准备${state.intent.hoursPerWeek}小时`]:[]),
      `已完成训练：${completed(state).length}/${lessonsFor(role.id).length}`, ...(state.trainingSkipped?[`学习安排：先完成模拟面试，余下${lessonsFor(role.id).length-completed(state).length}项训练可回到学习计划补学。`]:[]), ...completed(state).map((id,index)=>`${index+1}. ${lessonsFor(role.id).find(lesson=>lesson.id===id)?.title||id}`),
      ...(specialist()?.forRole(role.id)?['进度说明：这里记录知识讲解与情境练习；后续独立任务和实际作品仍需完成、复核，不等同于岗位能力认证。']:[]),
      ...state.interview.answers.flatMap((answer,index)=>{const round=roundFor(state,index);return [`问题${index+1}：${round.question}`,`我的回答：${answer.text}`,`可以保留：${round.feedback.keep}`,`下次改进：${round.feedback.improve}`,`再练一次：${round.feedback.nextTry}`];}),
      '下一步',...(data().nextSteps?.[role.id]||[]),'准备好后，带上这些记录去参加真实面试。每次复盘，都会更进一步。'].join('\n\n');
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyModel=Object.freeze({fresh,normalize,reduce,roleFor,lessonsFor,canOpenLesson,planFor,roundFor,reportText,trainingDone,onboardingSteps,canInterview,lessonStudied,reportsFor,reportState});
})();

</script>
